key_insight: Combining UMAP with DBSCAN improved unsupervised clustering of breast cancer electronic health record data, helping reveal patient groups with potentially meaningful clinical patterns.
clinical_relevance: This approach may support exploratory analysis of routine EHR data to surface hidden subgroups for further medical interpretation and research.
method: Applied DBSCAN to three independent breast cancer EHR datasets.
Used UMAP before DBSCAN to reduce dimensionality and improve clustering.
Assessed cluster quality with DBCV, DCSI, and DISCO.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent clustering performance across three datasets and evaluates results using three statistical cluster-validity indices.
watch_item: Because the findings are unsupervised and based on clustering metrics, the discovered groups still require expert validation before any clinical use.
paper_title: An unsupervised clustering analysis of breast cancer data derived from electronic health records enhanced through UMAP dimensionality reduction
